from typing import Optional, List

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from shared.model.config_database import ConfigDatabase
from shared.model.config_jobs import ConfigJobs
from shared.model.config_message_queue_service import ConfigMessageQueueService
from shared.model.config_service import ConfigService
from shared.model.logging_config import LoggingConfig
from .gpu_watchdog_options import GPUWatchdogOptions
from .language_detector_config import LanguageDetectorConfig
from ..presets.preset import Preset
from ..lib.extensions.config import ConfigExtension


class ProxyOptions(BaseModel):
    http: Optional[str] = Field(None)
    https: Optional[str] = Field(None)
    no_proxy: Optional[str] = Field(None,
                                    description="Comma-separated list of hosts/domains that bypass the proxy (e.g. 'localhost,127.0.0.1,.internal.corp')")

class ModelCacheConfig(BaseModel):
    cleanup_interval: Optional[int] = Field(600,
                                                description="Clean up models refs in model cache after given time of inactivity (in seconds)")

    cleanup_mem_threshold: Optional[int] = Field(70,
                                                 description="Free cached models once the memory of the device holding "
                                                             "them reaches this percentage — system RAM for CPU models, "
                                                             "its own memory for each GPU. The least recently used idle "
                                                             "model goes first and only until usage is back under the "
                                                             "line; models a job is still using are never dropped. "
                                                             "0 disables the check")


class ConfigRoot(BaseModel):
    ui_dir: Optional[str] = Field(default="ui", description="UI dir")

    upload_dir: Optional[str] = Field(default="tmp/upload", description="Upload dir")

    uploaded_unlink_after_process: Optional[bool] = Field(True,
                                                          description="Delete uploaded file if process was finished")


    gpu_min_free_mb: Optional[int] = Field(0,
                                           description="Minimum free memory (in MB) a GPU has to report before a job "
                                                       "is placed on it. 0 disables the check; when no GPU qualifies "
                                                       "the job runs on the CPU")

    model_cache: Optional[ModelCacheConfig] = Field(default=ModelCacheConfig(), description="Model cache options")

    gpu_watchdog: Optional[GPUWatchdogOptions] = Field(GPUWatchdogOptions(), description="GPU watchdog options")

    logging: Optional[LoggingConfig] = Field(default=LoggingConfig())

    database: Optional[ConfigDatabase] = Field(default=ConfigDatabase())

    server: Optional[ConfigService] = Field(default=ConfigService())

    jobs: Optional[ConfigJobs] = Field(default=ConfigJobs())
